name: marketing-studio-starter
description: A starter marketing content studio for Claude. Type /start - it asks which team you are on and what you want to do, then routes: a new campaign, a new asset, an update, or everyday work. Skills hold the method; your facts come from your own knowledge sources. Fill in house-rules once and every skill writes in your voice. Set up your knowledge base and brand system in three guided steps, then personalise approved copy with Cherry, the Red Tailor. Copy first, design second, nothing invented.
